response.description: Turning application code into a running cloud app often requires developers to configure build pipelines, deployment workflows, and hosting infrastructure. Azure App Service Builder simplifies that journey with a source-connected platform for building, deploying, and running web applications on Azure. Developers and AI coding agents can connect a GitHub repository and deploy a static site, backend web app, or frontend-plus-API application while the service manages the underlying build and hosting infrastructure. Portal, CLI, and guided GitHub Copilot app experience bring deployment into the workflows developers already use.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure App Service Builder
